decision.statement: Given a fixed set of two-stage fast-charge protocols and declared operating conditions, select the protocol that reaches the constant-voltage phase soonest in the worst declared condition while meeting every constraint in every declared condition, or abstain if none qualifies.
decision.intended_use: Public synthetic DEVELOPMENT study: does Carbon's scoring prefer models that select better reference-verified protocols? Not a cell qualification, lifetime, warranty or safety claim.
decision.adaptation: one protocol per scenario; no per-condition protocol choice
decision.claim_scope: Charging speed is measured as time to constant-voltage onset (the voltage proxy below), not time to a target state of charge. The 30-cycle reference is not extrapolated to real-cell lifetime or safety.

operating_conditions.rule: Conditions are fixed by the scenario; a selector cannot choose them.

objective.name: worst_case_time_to_cv_onset
objective.definition: For each condition, the time from charge start (the end of the reference's 120 s initial rest) to the first crossing of the terminal voltage above 4.19 V on the 30 s grid, by linear interpolation; the objective is the maximum over the scenario's conditions.
objective.unreached: NOT_REACHED_IN_WINDOW: the protocol fails the reach constraint in that condition; its objective is undefined, never the window length.

constraints.meaning: cycle-1 minimum plating overpotential stays non-negative
maximum volume-averaged temperature over the first hour

preferences_status: The thresholds, candidate grid, baseline, minimum useful improvement and mistake costs are provisional DEVELOPMENT engineering preferences. No customer declared them and none is commercially qualified.

mistake_costs.unit: multiples of the minimum useful improvement

baseline.method: fixed conservative default declared before any evaluation

tie_rule: lowest predicted objective; exact ties broken by lower c1, then lower c2

reference.generator: carbon.battery.reference (PyBaMM 26.8.0.0, DFN, OKane2022, 30 cycles), pinned truth image and overlay lock
measurement_limitations: voltage and temperature are kept only over the first 3600 s on a 30 s grid
no state-of-charge or current trajectory is recorded, so time to a target state of charge is not measurable
the plating margin is a cycle-1 minimum, not a lifetime plating measure

uncertainty.treatment: a reference value within the band of a threshold is UNRESOLVED, never forced to pass or fail; a missing or failed reference is REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE, never a candidate failure
uncertainty.basis: maximum observed shift between standard and refined solves of the refined TRAIN cases (docs/development/evidence/exam-design-2026-09-24/refs-a-part*)

models.reconstruction: Carbon rebuilds each declared recipe with its declared seed through the battery construction contract
models.repetition: reconstruction seeds are repetitions of one recipe, never separate model families
models.prediction_access: models receive only design variables and operating conditions; reference answers are never visible to training or selection

scoring_candidates.control: carbon.battery.exam.v1 approved DEVELOPMENT rule: gates, then mean normalized case error

components.physics: NOT_MEASURABLE for battery: no defensible physics measurement exists; the gates are mandatory checks, not a score
components.robustness: 1/(1+E_important): mean normalized case error over the published important region
components.accuracy: 1/(1+E): mean normalized case error over all scorable cases

scoring_candidates.aggregation: carbon.development-weight-profile.v1 weighted geometric mean; zero weights removed from ranking, gates kept
scoring_candidates.scoring_data: retained exam-design private-role references (pscreen, pfinal, pverify), public since the campaign reveal

acceptance.rule_selection: on development scenarios, choose the profile whose model ranking has the highest Kendall tau with the decision-loss ranking; ties go to the control
acceptance.verification: freeze the chosen profile, then report its agreement on the verification scenarios; revising after inspecting them makes them development evidence
acceptance.success_condition: Carbon can compare several models on the same engineering decision and show whether its scoring prefers models that select better reference-verified designs

data_scope.permitted_use: public DEVELOPMENT evidence; no client material; client studies require the private execution route
